fish.title: Little girl 5 year old soft warm

beats.speaker: Narrator
beats.text: Once upon a time, in a city called Destruction, there lived a bear named Christian.

beats.speaker: Narrator
beats.text: On his back, Christian carried a great, heavy burden. And every day, it grew heavier… and heavier.

beats.speaker: Christiana
beats.text: Christian, dear, you have been sighing all week over that heavy burden on your back.

beats.speaker: Christiana
beats.text: You keep saying our city will not stand… it frightens the cubs, you know.

beats.speaker: Christian
beats.text: I know, my dear. But I read it in my book, and I cannot forget it. I must find a way to be saved.

beats.speaker: Christiana
beats.text: If you truly must find answers, they say a wise bear called Evangelist walks the east road.

beats.speaker: Elsie
beats.text: Papa! Why do you always carry that big lumpy backpack?

beats.speaker: Elsie
beats.text: It looks SO heavy. I tried to lift it once and fell right over. Plop!
beats.say: It looks so heavy! I tried to lift it once, and fell right over. Plop!

beats.speaker: Anna
beats.text: Papa, I found a honey-flower by the well! Want to smell it?
beats.say: Papa, I found a honey flower by the well! Want to smell it?

beats.speaker: Anna
beats.text: It smells like… like honey!

beats.speaker: Narrator
beats.text: But Christian could not rest. So he set off down the east road, all alone, with his burden on his back.

beats.speaker: Obstinate
beats.text: Hmph. Still going on about the city falling down, Christian?
beats.say: Humph. Still going on about the city falling down, Christian?
beats.fish: [annoyed grunt] Hmph. Still going on about the city falling down, Christian?

beats.speaker: Obstinate
beats.text: Leave if you like — but no sensible creature will go with you. Hmph!
beats.say: Leave if you like. But no sensible creature will go with you. Humph!

beats.speaker: Narrator
beats.text: There, on the road, he met a tall, kind bear in a shining white robe. His name was Evangelist.

beats.speaker: Evangelist
beats.text: Peace to you, burdened friend. I am called Evangelist. Why do you sigh so?

beats.speaker: Christian
beats.text: This burden on my back grows heavier each day… and I fear our city will not stand. But I do not know where to go!

beats.speaker: Evangelist
beats.text: Then hear me. Beyond the fields lies a Wicket Gate, the beginning of the true way.

beats.speaker: Christian
beats.text: A gate? I look and look, but I cannot see any gate…

beats.speaker: Evangelist
beats.text: Can you see that shining light far away?

beats.speaker: Christian
beats.text: …I… yes! I think I see it!
beats.say: I... yes! I think I see it!

beats.speaker: Evangelist
beats.text: Keep that light in your eye and go straight toward it. There you will find the Gate. Now run, Christian — run and do not look back!
beats.say: Keep that light in your eye, and go straight toward it. There you will find the Gate. Now run, Christian! Run, and do not look back!

beats.speaker: Narrator
beats.text: So Christian began to run!

beats.speaker: Obstinate
beats.text: CHRISTIAN! Stop right there, you great woolly fool! Come back at once!
beats.say: Christian! Stop right there, you great woolly fool! Come back at once!

beats.speaker: Christian
beats.text: I cannot stay, neighbours. This city will not last. I am searching for a country that can never crumble. You have seen the light ahead — come with me!
beats.say: I cannot stay, neighbours. This city will not last. I am searching for a country that can never crumble. You have seen the light ahead. Come with me!

beats.speaker: Obstinate
beats.text: What?! Leave our friends, our comforts, our whole city — for a dream out of that book of yours?
beats.say: What?! Leave our friends, our comforts, our whole city, for a dream out of that book of yours?

beats.speaker: Christian
beats.text: What I seek is worth more than all we would leave behind. Come and see for yourselves!

beats.speaker: Obstinate
beats.text: Bah! I'll not be dragged on any fool's errand. Pliable — take his other arm. We are hauling him home.
beats.say: Bah! I'll not be dragged on any fool's errand. Pliable, take his other arm. We are hauling him home.

beats.speaker: Pliable
beats.text: Weeeell… actually, Obstinate… golden crowns? Streets of light? A city that never crumbles? …My paws are tingling.
beats.say: Well... actually, Obstinate... golden crowns? Streets of light? A city that never crumbles? ... My paws are tingling!

beats.speaker: Pliable
beats.text: I'm going WITH him! Think of it — glory, adventure, and no more of your grumbling!
beats.say: I'm going with him! Think of it! Glory, adventure, and no more of your grumbling!

beats.speaker: Obstinate
beats.text: You TOO?! Of all the—! FINE! Go drown in a bog together, the pair of you! I am going home like a SENSIBLE creature. HMPH!
beats.say: You too?! Of all the... Fine! Go drown in a bog together, the pair of you! I am going home, like a sensible creature. Humph!

beats.speaker: Pliable
beats.text: Don't mind him. Lead the way, friend Christian — hop hop!
beats.say: Don't mind him. Lead the way, friend Christian! Hop hop!

beats.speaker: Narrator
beats.text: And so Christian and Pliable set off together, through the gate in the city wall, toward the shining light.

beats.speaker: Narrator
beats.text: But the road ahead holds a very muddy surprise. Next time: the Slough of Despond!
